differential.scope: Single tax rule, gross/net quantity, calculated flag, cash/math rounding. Excludes lists/reference/regulation prices, tax-free and multi-rule allocation.

checks: B2C cart uses server price and tax
eight concurrent retries create exactly one order
same idempotency key cannot purchase another cart
B2B auth rotates context; quantity tier and net tax calculation
real Wasm purchase limit blocks company checkout
UCP checkout uses integer minor units
UCP create/get, currency minor units and context authorization
UCP PUT replaces items and buyer atomically
Admin catalog endpoint requires merchant authority
Wasm source compiled at activation and persisted
durable outbox has a working consumer
real LLM produces correct typed merchant plan
real customer inference selects existing product

load.environment: localhost, six products, debug binary, PostgreSQL Docker; no external network, no LLM
load.comparison: No Shopware baseline; not a production capacity claim

limits: Single tax-rule port, not complete Shopware parity
Prototype API envelopes, not drop-in SDK compatibility
Partial MCP/UCP bindings, no full conformance
Persisted policy, no online LLM weight training or economic uplift proof
Local small-catalog load, no PHP or production baseline
